task.instruction: Recommend a first-use pattern for an empty workspace where users want both quick structure and room for unusual projects.
task.deliverable: A starter-pattern recommendation, ownership invariant, and evidence basis.

evidence.content: Synthetic notes show 12 of 20 users choose a standard starter; 8 reject it because their work has non-linear stages.
A synthetic workspace-governance requirement says every created workspace must visibly name its owner, whether it starts from a standard starter or a configurable map.
A configurable map helps the non-linear group but adds six choices before first content; the starter opens immediately.

A.content: When existing patterns do not fit the stated constraints, prefer a new approach whose risks can be tested explicitly.

B.content: When a proven pattern fits the stated constraints, prefer its established behavior and known operational costs.

irrelevant.content: Use parallel grammar for items in the final list.
